items.program_name: Real-Time Operating Reserves (TMSR / TMNSR / TMOR) - real-time reserve pricing
items.incentive_structure: $/MWh real-time reserve clearing price paid on designated reserve MW in 5-minute intervals; non-zero only when ISO must re-dispatch to hold reserves
items.incentive_value_usd: Fall 2025 average non-zero prices: TMSR $22.63/MWh (133.4 hours priced; $13.82/MWh excl. Nov 23 2025 scarcity day), TMNSR $200.38/MWh (9.8 h), TMOR $151.86/MWh (9.7 h); Fall 2024: TMSR $6.39 (196.1 h), TMNSR $15.06 (0.3 h), TMOR $0.00 (0 h)
items.event_limits: Demand Response Resources are co-optimized for energy and reserves in real time (Price-Responsive Demand framework, Jun 1 2018). During the Nov 23 2025 capacity scarcity condition the 30-minute reserve price hit $1,000/MWh (30-min RCPF) and total 10-minute reserve price $2,500/MWh (30-min price + $1,000 10-min RCPF); oil, hydro and battery storage units ramping up created ten-minute spinning reserves. Four intervals in Fall 2025 had a binding TMNSR RCPF ($1,500/MWh above TMOR)
items.tariff_schedule: Market Rule 1 (real-time reserve pricing - section number not verified); ISO Operating Procedure OP-8
items.stackable_with: Energy market (co-optimized); DA A/S awards; capacity (Pay-for-Performance)
